title: Find a contact
summary: Looks a person up in the person's own contacts on this device, read only and only when contact access is already on: name, company, phone and email.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks for someone's number, email or contact details.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The person's name as they said it

_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Contacts applet for the agent, through its own service.
